rom: az yashir-Moshe uvenei Yisra'el et-hashirah hazzot laYHWH vayyomeru lemor ashirah laYHWH ki-ga'oh ga'ah sus verokhvo ramah vayyam.
'ozzi vezimrat yah vayhi-li lishu'ah zeh eli ve'anvehu elohei avi va'aromemenhu.
markevot Par'oh vekheilo yarah vayyam umivkhar shalishav tubbe'u veyam-suf.
yeminekha YHWH ne'dari bakkoakh yeminekha YHWH tir'ats oyev.
uverov ge'onekha taharos kamekha teshallakh kharonekha yokhelemo kakkash.
uveruakh appekha ne'ermu mayim nitsevu khemo-ned nozelim kafe'u tehomot belev-yam.
amar oyev erdof assig akhallek shalal timla'emo nafshi arik kharbi torishemo yadi.
nashafta veruakhakha kissamo yam tsalelu ka'oferet bemayim addirim.
mi-khamokhah ba'elim YHWH mi kamokhah ne'dar bakkodesh nora tehillot 'oseh fele.
nakhita vekhasdekha 'am-zu ga'alta nehalta ve'ozzekha el-neveh kodshekha.
shame'u 'ammim yirgazun khil akhaz yoshevei Pelashet.
az nivhalu allufei Edom eilei Mo'av yokhazemo ra'ad namogu kol yoshevei Khena'an.
tippol 'aleihem eimatah vafakhad bigdol zero'akha yiddemu ka'aven 'ad-ya'avor 'ammekha YHWH 'ad-ya'avor 'am-zu kanita.
tevi'emo vetitta'emo behar nakhalatekha makhon leshivtekha pa'alta YHWH mikkedash Adonai konenu yadekha.
notes: SHAPE: orig is ONE stanza of 18 lines (one per verse, Exodus 15:1-18); the KJV 'en' in texts/song-of-the-sea.json is 18 stanzas of one line each. Same verses, different nesting: one of the two needs reshaping before they are paired.
KJV import slip, verse 8: 'the floods floods stood upright as an heap' has 'floods' twice (KJV: 'the floods stood upright'). Fix in the import.
line 1.10: the source has a stray U+FB1E (Hebrew point judeo-spanish varika) in 'tsalelu' (צָֽלְﬞלוּ), a typographic mark of the Wikisource edition; ignored in rom, worth cleaning in orig.
line 1.1 begins with the narrative frame ('Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to YHWH and said:'), not part of the song itself.
The divine name is romanized as written, YHWH (read Adonai), and YAH as yah (line 1.2); line 1.17 writes Adonai itself (אדני) and is romanized so. The editor may prefer 'Adonai' for YHWH throughout.

Cantillation marks and the paseq are not romanized; qamats katan read as o (kodshekha, 'ozzekha). Initial aleph unmarked, other aleph and all ayin as '; dagesh forte doubled except in sh, ts, kh; maqqef as a hyphen.
